name: Salsa moña horn line
desc: The moña: a legato octave-doubled horn line rather than stabs, weaving a continuous singable hook through an I-vi-IV-V vamp in Bb (Bb Gm Eb F) that turns over each cycle, drenched in dotted delay. Sawtooth section with a slow filter bloom; peak breaks into fast 16th unison runs that leap the octave.

code.sparse: note("<[d5 ~ f5 ~ bb4 d5 ~ f5] [d5 ~ bb4 ~ g4 bb4 ~ d5] [g4 ~ bb4 ~ eb4 g4 ~ bb4] [a4 ~ c5 ~ f4 a4 ~ c5]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").attack(.02).decay(.3).sustain(.5).release(.15).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}*1.2).slow(16)).lpq(2).shape(.25).gain(${gain}*.9).room(${room}).delay("${wet}:.375:.4").orbit(5).play()
code.full: note("<[[d5,d4] f5 [bb4,bb3] d5 [f5,f4] d5 [bb4,bb3] f5] [[d5,d4] bb4 [g4,g3] bb4 [d5,d4] g5 [d5,d4] bb4] [[g4,g3] bb4 [eb5,eb4] g5 [bb4,bb3] eb5 [g4,g3] bb4] [[a4,a3] c5 [f5,f4] a5 [c5,c4] f5 [a4,a3] c5]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").attack(.008).decay(.25).sustain(.6).release(.15).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.4).slow(16)).lpq(3).shape(.5).gain(${gain}).room(${room}).delay("${wet}:.375:.45").lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(5).play()
code.peak: note("<[d4 f4 bb4 a4 f4 d4 bb3 d4 f4 bb4 a4 f4 d4 bb3 f3 d3] [d4 bb3 g3 bb3 d4 g4 d4 bb3 g3 bb3 d4 g4 d4 bb3 g3 d3] [g3 bb3 eb4 g4 eb4 bb3 g3 bb3 eb4 g4 bb4 g4 eb4 bb3 g3 eb3] [a3 c4 f4 a4 f4 c4 a3 c4 f4 a4 c5 a4 f4 c4 a3 f3]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").attack(.012).decay(.2).sustain(.5).release(.12).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.6).slow(8)).lpq(3).shape(.5).gain(${gain}).room(${room}).delay("${wet}:.375:.5").off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(${gain}*.4)).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(5).play()
